protocol.ordering: Adjacent ABBA/BAAB fresh processes; identical iterations per pair

contract: Complete matmul -> bias -> scale -> ReLU -> balanced sum; exact dyadic runtime inputs. Fresh output/intermediate allocation, scheduling, dispatch and cleanup included. GPU scalar completion/readback included; transfers adds three uploads. Initialization, compilation and shader loading excluded. Same shaders/driver/runtime archive, only Metal implementation differs. CPU and BLAS controls are numerical API comparisons, not source-compiler rankings. BLAS can use different GEMM arithmetic/layout/hardware; chosen timed inputs have exact matrix entries. Libraries map and reduce their output in place; Kalandra owns its lowering strategy. No affinity/frequency/host isolation.
